tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dge legs myur 'grub ces bya ba zhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dge legs myur 'grub ces bya ba zhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dge legs myur 'grub ces bya ba zhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa bgyi ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po'i sdom ni/ legs bsham bdag bum mdun dbang blang*// rten sbyang bkru phyi dam tshig bskyed// ye shes spyan drangs bzhugs mchod bstod// snyan gsan rten dgab tshogs gsog bya// zhes bcu bzhi las// dang po legs par bsham pa ni/ sngar ma sbyang ba'i sa phyogs su ni sa'i cho ga zhi khro'i dbang phreng nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ sbyangs zin pa'i gnas su sgrub po'i g.yas su rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bum pa gnyis dbang rdzas dang bcas pa bshams/ rten gyi drung du mnga' dbul gyi dkyil 'khor ri rab gling bzhi gling phran 'khor yug rgya mtsho bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis spras pa bris pa'i steng du rgyal srid bdun dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad dang*/ de'i mthar mnga' dbul rten la nyer mkho rnams bshams pa'i mthar ci 'byor ba'i mchod pas bskor ba dang*/ khrus stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i khrus gzhong dang*/ gzhan yang khrus ras rgyal ba lnga'i sa bon bris pa dang*/ 'dag 'chal me long*/ gos zung*/ rol mo sogs nyer mkho rnams gang dgos bya zhing*/ gnas khang yol ba dang bla bre sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dgos pa skabs don dang 'brel ba mthong brgyud ltar bkod legs par bsham mo// gnyis pa bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ rtsa gsum las byang ltar rdzogs rim yan grub par bya/ gsum pa bum bskyed ni/ las bum la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dkyil chog ltar mi bskyed par bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon g.yas rdo rje'i dbyig pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa khro bo'i chas du ma dang ldan par bskyed cing sngags kyang a mṛ ta'i tshab tu/

oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla bar bkra shis brtsegs pa nas gsungs so// bum bsnyen gyi skabs rab tu gnas bya'i lha de'i sngags kyang brgya phrag tsam bzla bar gsungs so// dkyil chog ltar la/ bzlas pa'i dus/ rnam rgyal bum ba'i lha gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sa bon la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba'i mthar rten 'brel snying pos bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs nas de nyid du thim par gyur par bsam/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ ye dhar btags la ci 'grub bzla/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la brgyud de song ba lha'i thugs kar phog pas rten 'brel snying po las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar bsam mo// bzhi pa mdun bskyed dang*/ lnga pa bdag 'jug rnams kyang dkyil chog ltar bya'o// drug pa rten sbyang ba ni/ sgrub pa po 'grengs te sbyang chas 'du byas par chus bran te/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ zhi bas sbyang ba ni/ gtor ma gsum re re nas slob dpon gyis rten la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes bskor zhing gsog snod du dor/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ni/ ting lo g.yon du bskor dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la dor/ drag pos sbyang ba ni/ rgyas par na khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod rnams gzhan ltar dang*/ bsdus par na/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i mthus/ bde bar gshegs pa che ge'i sku gsung thugs gang yin/ rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams gtor mas lam rgyags/ chang bus lam zan/ ting los lam sgron gyis la gnas 'dir ma 'dug par song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas sreg cing brlag par gdon mi za'o// zhes brjod cing hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ rten la gu gul bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo drag tu sgrog gu gul dang yungs kar la thog ma nas oṃ ma gu ta la pra ta la hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang hūm̐ bzhi sogs mang du bzla ba gal che'o// mchan/ de nas byur dang sdig sbyang ba ni/ hūm̐ bzlas pa'i yungs kar dang*/ oṃ bzlas pa'i chu khyor pa g.yas g.yon du thogs pa rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes kham phor gyi nang du mer dor ba lan gsum bya'o// bdun pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ rten dngos su bkru btub na de nyid dang*/ mi btub na me long du shar ba la/ ba'i rnam lnga tsan+dan dang sbyar ba/ dūrba'i pir gyis byugs la las bum gyi chus bkru zhing*/ hūm̐ */ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yi// byin rlabs ye shes chu yi khrus// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus gsol bas// dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ a mṛ te sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ khrus ras kyis phyi zhing*/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyi'o// mi shes dri ma ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ til sogs 'bru mar sran dkar gyi phye ma dang sbyar ba byug cing bkru bas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar| |lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes dri ma ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba= /u duṃ wā ra sogs shing shun gyi phye mas byug cing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ sarba= rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes dri ma ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba= dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar bas byug cing skyu ru ra'i 'dag 'chal dang bcas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba= rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes dri ma ma lus rab bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba= rol mo sgrog cing khrus gsol lo// khrus gsol ba'i tshe nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa byon pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas rten legs par bkrus par bsam mo// mchan/ de nas gos zung 'bul zhing*/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' dam pa shin tu dri zhim pa// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul// oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā/ zhes so// brgyad pa dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ bsgrub bya bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lte ba mthing ga mu khyud ser po can gyi chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po zhes pa nas/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i bar dkyil chog ltar bskyed/

dgu pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ sgrub po rnams spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi// bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams rgya mtsho bcas// 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams ni dga' ldan nas// sprul pa dam pa tog dkar lha yi bu// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas// gzigs pa rnam bzhis 'dzam gling kun gzigs shing*// glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs lhums zhugs ltar// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i rigs mchog dang*// las kyi rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// dus 'dir bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na// rten mchog 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gsum brjod/ bcu pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ rnam lnga 'dod kor las gdan dbul ba'i rgya dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon= /'di nyid du ni= /stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab rgyas ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes dmigs/ skabs 'dir dkon mchog rjes dran bklag par gsungs so// mchan/ bcu gcig pa mchod bstod dkyil chog ltar bya/ bcu gnyis pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ na mo/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas na// bzhugs pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus 'khor dang bcas// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen bsgrub phyir dang*// khyed rnams mchod phyir rab tu gnas pa bgyid 'tshal na// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams byin gyis rlob pa dang*// nangs par rten mchog rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsum gsol/

bcu gsum pa rten dgab pa ni/ mchod cing bstod la/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags nas/ grub na skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o// mchan/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can= /ji lta'i rjes mthun= /sangs rgyas yul du= /slar yang 'byon par= /badz+ra muḥ zhes dang*/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i rgya thur bstan spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha/ rten gyi ye shes pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rten rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ rten la dar ser po bkab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra wa ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bcu bzhi pa tshogs dang sogs khongs kyi sgras bskul la sogs pa rnams rtsa gsum las gzhung ltar byas la rang dang gnas bsrung zhing nyal lo// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i sdom la/ bdag bum mdun dbang rten sbyang bkru// rten sgrub sgo lnga dbye rgyan gos// gsol gdab spyan drangs gzhung dbang bskur// byin rlabs spyan dbye zhal bsgyur bya// brtan bzhugs rab gnas mnga' dbul ba'o// zhes pa bcu dgu las/ dang po bdag bskyed/ gnyis pa bum pa/ gsum pa mdun bskyed/ bzhi pa bdag 'jug /lnga pa rten sbyang ba/ drug pa bkru zhing phyi ba rnams sta gon kho na ltar bya zhing*/ bdun pa rten bsgrub pa ni/ sta gon gyi bskyed pa'i skabs ltar bya/ rab gnas zhag mang du byed na 'dir rten de ga'i snying po mang du bzla zhing snying po med pa'i mchod rten sogs la rten 'brel snying po mang du bzla'o// mchan/ brgyad pa sgo lnga dbye ba ni/ gser gyi mig thur/ lcags kyi 'jab rtse/ ra gan gyi thur ma/ dngul gyi so shing*/ zangs kyi rna brus rnams dri bzang gis sbags pa thogs la/ mgon po bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la// gus pa mchog gi sri zhu bskyed pa'i phyir// rin chen gser gyi thur mas zhal dbye zhing*// rin chen lcags kyi 'jab rtses shangs bsal la// ra gan thur mas ye shes zhal mchog phye// dngul gyi so shing mchog gis tshems skyon bsal// zangs kyi thur mas snyan mchog kun nas dbye// oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣuḥlam+bo dha ra ā lo ke te a pa ra pa ti ra pra we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

dgu pa rgyan gos dbul ba ni/ na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan phreng thogs la/ mgon po bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la// gus pa mchog gi sri zhu bskyed pa'i phyir// rnam mang rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs dang*// rab mdzes dar gyi na bza' dbul bar bgyi// oṃ dzñā na a laṅkā ra am+ba ra pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes dbul/ bcu pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sgrub po rnams 'grengs te me tog dor spos sreg cing*/ gang 'di ltar zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa yon tan thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs dang*/ las kyi rigs dang*| de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rigs la sogs pa/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas me tog dang bcas pas lan gsum gsol zhing re re'i mthar yang phyag 'tshal lo// bcu gcig pa spyan drang ba ni/ spos thogs rdor dril dang bcas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas 'og min la sogs pa nas ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs par gyur/ hūm̐ */ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur byon bcom ldan 'das// ye shes lha mchog zhi khro'i tshogs| |thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// zhes pa nas// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes pa'i bar dang*/

e h+ye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs pas ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ bcu gnyis pa bzhugs pa ni/ bcom ldan dam tshig rten 'di la// gnyis su med par rab bzhugs te// ji srid 'khor ba de srid du// sems can don du bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ sa ma ya baṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod pas sta gon gyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa dang spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa gnyis 'dres te dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ ye dharma he tu pra bha wa sogs brjod cing me tog dor/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyang nam mkha' gang bar byon nas rten la thim par gyur par bsam mo// bcu gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// zhes pa nas/ zhi khro sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// bar gyi sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// nas/ de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis steng phyogs su gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa 'dzin cing me tog gi char 'bebs/ rgyal ba lnga'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ rig ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long*/ sku 'bag sogs bsnams nas bsgrub bya la dbang bskur bar gyur par bsams la/

slob dpon gyis mi bskyod pa zhi khro dang bum pa thogs la dbang bskur ba'i tshul gyis/ hūm̐ */ mthing gsal chos dbyings ye shes dkyil 'khor na// sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ rin 'byung zhi khro dang dbu rgyan thogs la/ hūm̐ */ ser gsal mnyam nyid ye shes sogs sngags bcas dang*/ dpag med zhi khro dang rdo rjes/ hūm̐ */ dmar gsal ye shes sogs sngags bcas/ don grub zhi khro dang dril bus/ hūm̐ */ ljang gsal bya grub ye shes sogs sngags bcas/ rtag pa zhi khro dang rdor dril gyis/ hūm̐ */ dkar gsal me long ye shes sogs sngags bcas/ bdud rtsi thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ bdud rtsi byang sems rnam pa lnga// sogs sngags bcas/ las rgya thogs la/ hūm̐ */ ye shes lnga ldan bde ba'i sku// sogs sngags bcas/ shel dang sku 'bag thogs la/ kye ho skal ldan bu rnams nyon// sogs sngags bcas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long thogs la/ kye hoḥ skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams bdag la nyon// sogs sngags bcas kyis dbang bskur/ bar gyi dag pa gsol gdab rnams mi dgos/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rab tu gnas bya'i rten la thim/ oṃ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ bcu bzhi pa byin gyis brlabs shing rgyas gdab pa ni/ slob dpon gyi g.yas pa'i srin mdzub rdo rje dang bcas pas dri'i chus rten gyi gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par gyur/ ces brjod/ bco lnga pa spyan dbye ba ni/ dngul snod du sbrang rtsi dri bzang dang sbyar ba gser gyi thur mas blangs pa mig dbye ba'i rgyas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog

/oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣuḥbi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes gsum bya/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes kyi spyan dwangs pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs rje'i gzigs pa lhur mdzad par gyur par bsam/ bcu drug pa zhal bsgyur ba ni/ mchod cing bstod la/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi lha rnams yongs su gyur pa la rten so so'i rnam par gyur par mos/ bcu bdun pa brtan bzhugs ni/ rdo rje rten rnams kyi thugs kar reg la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag rten 'di yang 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas zhig par ma gyur gyi bar de srid du sems can thams cad kyi don du dgongs te sangs rgyas byang sems rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs thams cad rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs so gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes gsum bya zhing me tog dor/ skabs 'dir bris sku yin na rgyab tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ sogs rgyab yig gdab/ 'bur sku la de nyid mang du bzlas pa'i rdo rjes reg cing me tog dor ro// bco brgyad pa rab gnas ni/ rten gyi thugs kar gzung thag rdo rje btags pa'i sne mo slob dpon gyis bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam zhi khro dpa' po mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar spyan drangs/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la bstims pas gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ zhi khro'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhū khaṃ badz+rī bha wa dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/

dang*/ de'i mthar/ ye dhar btags pa ci mang bzla'o// bcu dgu pa mnga' dbul ba spyi dang bye brag khyad par gsum las/ dang po la mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun la sogs pa gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar 'bul/ dkyil chog nas 'byung ba'i bstod pas bstod do/ */gnyis pa bye brag tu mnga' dbul ba la/ dal khri khrus gos lnga bdun brgyad// bcud gdugs rnams ni spyir btang du'o// dang po dal sogs bzhi ni/ gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang*// seṅge'i khri chen dri mchog khrus kyi chu// lha rdzas rin thang med pa'i sna tshogs gos// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra su re khe singha ā sa na su gan+dha dza la am+ba ra pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan nyer spyod 'os pa'i tshogs// gzugs sogs rnam bkra lnga phrag du ma dang*// rgyal po'i srid la 'os pa'i rin chen bdun// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza āḥhūm̐| rtags brgyad lnga tshan lnga dang*/ gdugs ni/ lha dbang lha min dpung las rab rgyal tshe// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa dang*// lnga phrag snying po grags pa'i gdugs dkar rnams// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra aṣ+ṭa maṅga la pañtsa gar+bha ts+tsha traṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐/ sku gzugs spyi la smad bzed dang*// tshems shing rna brus mkhas pas dbul// mtshan dpe ldan pa'i sku mchog skyon bral yang*// 'gro ba'i don du 'dzin spyad dam pa dang*// tshems shing dang ni sgra 'dzin gsal byed mchog /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra dan+ta sho dha ya kar+ṇa ka shud+dha pū dza āḥhūm̐/ longs sku so mang khyad par rgyan// nges pa lnga ldan rgyal ba lnga mchod phyir// mthon mthing lcang lo mdzes byed so mang dang*// rin chen rgyan mchog dpag yas rab spen pa// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra bā la sho dha ya a laṅkā ra bi bhu kha na pū dza āḥhūm̐/

sprul sku spu gri snod chos gos// nges 'byung rtags sgrub gser gyi spu gri dang*// drang srong dka' thub snod mchog lhung bzed dang*// rnam gsum bka' rtags ngur smrig rgyal mtshan dang*// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mū la na khats+tshed badz+ra was+t+ra pū dza āḥhūm̐/ gsung rab khri gos glegs shing thag /brjid ldan seṅge'i khri dang lha yi gos// thabs shes gnyis mtshon rin chen glegs shing zung*// glegs bam 'ching gyur yo byad glegs thag rnams// spros bral gsung rab mchog la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ā sa na was+t+ra pusta kaṃ bṛk+ṣa ban+dha pū dza āḥhūm̐/ mchod rten srog shing 'khor lo 'phan// rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan/ /dang po drug ni/ rab brtan srog shing chos 'khor bcu gsum ldan// lha rdzas 'phan dang lda ldi gos rgyan sogs// mi nub rgyal mtshan grags pa'i gdugs dkar dang*| |rin chen phreng bcas chos sku'i rten la dbul// oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe dharma tsakra aṃ wa ra pa taṃ ka dh+wa dza ts+tsha traṃ mā le pū dza āḥhūm̐/ gdan ni/ 'gro ba'i don la g.yo med brtan pa'i phyir// gnyis 'thung dbang po dang ni gdong lnga pa// cang shes mchog dang rma bya mkha' lding dbang*// 'dab rgyas nyi ma zla ba rin po che// dar zab sna tshogs mdzes pa'i gdan khri rnams// chos sku'i rten mchog rnams la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra su tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na pū dza āḥhūm̐/ khro bor thod pa skam rlon dang*// zhing glang stag lpags khrag zhag thal// sbrul gdan me sman rak+ta gtor// rol mo rnams ni brjid ldan dbul| |thod skam sogs ni/ thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon phreng ba dang*// zhing chen gnyis 'thung stag lpags khrag dang zhag /thal chen lto 'gro pad nyi dbugs bral gdan// dpal chen khro bo'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ka pā la mā le na ra hasti byā gh+ra dzi na nā ga pad+ma sūr+ya ma traṃ ru tra ā sa na pū dza āḥhūm̐/

bskal pa'i me chen nyon mongs 'joms pa'i sman// ma hā rak+ta brjid ldan gtor ma'i tshogs// rkang gling rol mo drag po'i nga ror bcas// dpal chen khro bo'i tshogs la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ma hā kalpa ag+ni pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba liṃ ma hā shapad pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes skabs dang sbyar la dbul/ gsum pa khyad par mnga' dbul ni/ tsā ru'i bza' ba bkra shis so/ */grub na tsā ru'i tshab tu rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gis lha rnams tshim par bya dgos so// dang po ni| rin po che'i snod du bza' ba dang btung ba sna tshogs pa bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe sogs gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'ong ba// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba 'khor bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā su pra ra sa pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes phud rnams rten gyi drung du 'bul/ gnyis pa bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ shis brjod rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar bya zhing me tog gi char dbab bo// spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba'i sdom la/ chos skyong bsgo zhing dkyil 'khor mchod// bstod pa dngos grub blang ba dang*// yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod// dga' ston gtang rag mchod cing bstod// dge rtsa bsngo zhing mjug bsdu ba'o// zhes pa ltar bcu gnyis las/ dang po chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ chos skyong gi gtor ma rgyas par bshams la/ chos skyong gang yin mdun du bskyed nas spyan 'dren dam bzhag mchod bstod gtor 'bul sogs chos skyong so so'i rang gzhung ltar byas rjes/ dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma mthu rtsal can rnams dang*/ nor skyong gzhi bdag dge bsnyen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa khyod rnams zhes sam/ che ge mo khyod kyis sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams kyi srung ma dang yon bdag gyis la ji srid phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du srung ba dang skyong bar gyis shig

|dam tshig las ma 'da' zhig /badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ṣa hūm̐?/ zhes bsgo/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil chog gam mchod phreng gzhan ltar gyis mchod/ gsum pa ni/ dkyil chog ltar ram spyi bstod gang rung gis bstod la bzod gsol ni| grub na chad lhag skong ba'i phyir skabs 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa gang mchis pa// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dang*// nongs par gyur pa gang lags pa// kun tu bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa gsum brjod// bzhi pa ni/ tsā ru'i phud rten la phul ba'i lhag ma rnams sgrub po rnams dang yon bdag la drangs shing*/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// gsol zhing sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur// zhes brjod cing longs spyad/ lnga pa ni/ yon bdag rnams mdun du 'khod pa la zhal skyems drangs shing*/ rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po khyod kyis bdag la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa legs par grub kyi/ rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig /de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgyun ma chad par gyis shig /de lta bus ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing bkra shis bde legs dang ldan pa dang rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ro// zhes bsgo/ drug pa ni/ sgrub po rnams kyis me tog rten la 'thor zhing mgrin gcig tu// bcom ldan rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can// tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus na grong khyer gnyan ldan du// shing mchog ta la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bde gshegs gtsug tor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can// tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na ka na'i grong khyer du// puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog

/rgyal ba thams cad skyob pa rgyal rigs blo gros can// tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer gnyan yod du// shing mchog sā la'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni stobs ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du// shīr+ṣa yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'dren pa gser thub bslab pa mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs// tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du// u duṃ wā ra'i shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can// tshe lo nyi khri'i dus na wā rā ṇa sī ru// n+ya gro dha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can// tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer du// a shwat+tha yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /bkra shis sangs rgyas bdun gyi bkra shis phun tshogs gang yin pa// phyogs bcu kun gyi bde legs byin rlabs rmad byung dang*// chos nyid rnam dag rten 'brel stobs ldan mi bslu bas// deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs ldan shog /ces shis pa brjod/ sbyin bdag rnams gos rgyan bzang po dang bcas mdun du stan dkar steng du 'khod pa la bkra shis kyi rdzas re re bzhin lag tu gtad la/ ngag tu/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med spyod pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman| |sman mchog rnam dag nyid du rtogs gyur nas// nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig

/zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa yi// snying po rnam dag ye shes rab rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don rnams grub gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te| |chos rnams ma lus yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma nor dbang du gyur nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang chos srid brtan gyur cig /yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus rab tu 'joms byed cing*| |mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /ces sbyin bdag gi lag tu gtad cing rten gyi drung du dbul/ gzhan yang shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// bdun pa ni/ dga' ston gyi bza' btung dang glu gar la sogs pa 'byor tshogs dang bstun par bya'o// brgyad pa gtang rag ni/ rdo rje slob dpon yon gyis mnyes par bya zhing sgrub po rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams yon gyis mnyes par byas so// dgu pa mchod pa dang*/ bcu pa bstod pa sogs kyang dkyil chog ltar ram spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// bcu gcig pa dge rtsa bsngo ba dang smon lam spyi mthun ltar bya/ bcu gnyis pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ dkyil chog dang rtsa gsum las byang ltar bya'o// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i rab 'byams las tshogs rnams// ma nor rnam dpyod blo yis kun phye nas// 'gro la dge ba'i lam bzang ston pa 'di// rdo rje 'dzin pa kho bo'i sgos skal yin// de ltar dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/

rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa dge legs myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam la mos pa deng sang med mod/ 'on kyang de 'dra srid na phan pa'i sems kyis gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje 'dzin pa mi bskyod rdo rje zhes sam/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas sa 'brug tha skar zla ba'i dkar cha'i dga' ba gsum pa'i dus dge bar lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //tshul 'di zhi khro kho na la sbyar gyi bla med gsar rnying gzhan la sbyor na bdag mdun bum pa rten bskyed pa sogs lha gang yin rang gzhung gi mngon rtogs sbyar zhing tshig gzhan zhi khro zhes pa'i 'don pa bsgyur/ sgrub rten la dbang bskur ba'i tshe lha rang gzhung gi dbang gang yin gyi dngos gzhi bskur bas legs par grub par 'gyur ba ni rnam dpyod dang ldan pas go bar byos la rang bzo ma byed cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
